title: Las Vegas Strip and Downtown Scooter with Souvenir T-shirt & Food Tour
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (if option selected)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Maximum height is 6’4″, while riding with a passenger
Maximum combined weight of passengers is 450 lbs per car
Minimum age is 8 for a passenger
Must be 21 with valid driver’s license to drive
policies: Please note: Price displayed is based per scooter and there is a maximum of two (2) passengers per scooter. If you have more than 2 passengers, you will need to book additional scooters. There is a maximum of seven (7) scooters per tour.
Tour route is subject to change due to any seen or unforeseen circumstance including but not limited to closing or filming
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See all of Las Vegas' famous sites such as the Welcome to Las Vegas sign, the world's largest chocolate fountain, filming locations of hit reality television shows and more on this 4-hour scooter tour. Hotel pickup and drop-off and delicious food from local favorites is included.

May - Oct Tours Start at 9:00 AM for Weather (Heat)
Nov-April Tours Start at 10:00 AM for Weather (Cold)
